init.title: Options
init.description:
Control lets Home Assistant change which source each receiver watches, and each receiver's audio mode. Start with Dry run: it only logs what it would send.

CEC forwarding passes HDMI-CEC (power on / standby) from the device on a source bridge to the TVs on its receivers. UniFi's firmware has it switched off, so Home Assistant logs in to the bridges over SSH to start it, again after every bridge restart and route change. It needs Control set to Live (Dry run only logs) and the bridges' SSH login from UniFi Network (Settings > System > Device SSH Authentication). Leave the password empty to keep the saved one. Details: docs/cec.md.
